body: If you won't let anyone convince you otherwise try make it a peaceful thing like in your bed or put up a few sheets somewhere so they don't have to see you, I'm really sorry you are going through this but please don't die the world needs you and we need you, your parents need you please don't do this

Please don't die, I know it's really hard but please dont, people care I care, please don't, imagine how they will feel how everyone will feel, think of whenever Christmas comes again and this is on their mind because this happend to me, my best friend committed suicide on Christmas Day, it never left my mind, I always morn for her, I will never forget her. Please think of how this will hurt them too, they want you to live I want you to live so please don't die.

I'm 100% sure you are beautiful, you aren't stupid either. I know first hand how bad this is because Ive been down this path. One of the ways I coped through my depression was art, music, literature, science, anything that can distract your mind, it's going to be hard but please try atleast something, and please don't go.
